scientific_integrity: Direct proof for all odd cycle lengths, separate finite exhaustive checks through 21 vertices; finite checks do not certify arbitrary lengths. Self-review only, no independent audit.
scientific_limitations: The exact fiber and basin formulas concern odd undirected cycles only; known Rule-5 evolution, periodic-point counting, and general preimage recursions are not claimed new. A relevant 1988 cylindrical-attractor paper was available only in abstract, so historical priority is qualified.
title: Fibonacci fibers and the uniquely dominant Lucas basin for odd-ring Rule 5
